newsitem.title: NETHERLANDS: DOCdata profit rises in first four mths 97.
newsitem.headline: DOCdata profit rises in first four mths 97.

text.p: Dutch compact disc maker DOCdata NV said on Thursday results over the first four months of 1997 were considerably higher year-on-year.

"Results for the first four months of 1997 were considerably ahead of the comparable period in 1996, reflecting growth particularly in DOCdata's CD manufacturing businesses in France and Germany," DOCdata said in a statement.

The newly-listed CD maker, which is quoted on Amsterdam and NASDAQ exchanges, said its U.S. subsidiary U.S. Optical Disc Inc had acquired diskette duplication equipment enabling it to boost annual capacity to over 50 million units.
U.S. Optical Disc currently has optical disc manufacturing capacity of some 25 million units annually, DOCdata said.
It said that the addition of diskette duplication capability was aimed at satisfying software developers' demands for single-source disc and diskette production.
